relics.choice_encoding: 1-based option number within each tier; vector slots are T1..T7

2.name: Golden Touch
effects: Goldenhawk boots grant passive Agility XP while moving, skilling, or using ultimate abilities.
Agility and Thieving can award goldenhawk feathers, which can be converted to Prayer XP or alchemised.
Agility course base XP and completion coins are doubled.
Agility obstacles and shortcuts cannot fail.
Pickpocketing always succeeds; non-coin loot is tripled and noted.
Stalls do not deplete and safes have no cooldown.
Repeated Thieving actions continue automatically.
Coins from Thieving are multiplied by 100.
Chests and safes can award extra banked herb and potion-ingredient bundles.

passive_effects: League XP multiplier is 5x.
Farming crops grow 5x faster.
Run energy rapidly restores to 100%.
The Archaeology Guild Shop is fully available without qualification requirements.
Chronotes from artefacts and collections are multiplied by 5.
Necromancy ritual souls are increased to 5x normal.
Standard boss instance spawn times are greatly reduced.
The Invention tutorial is treated as complete once Invention is unlocked; Invention starts at level 5 and tutorial tools/blueprints are available.

3.name: Divine Druid
effects: Thera's Summoning pouch stores grimy herbs and charms.
Summoning pouches require no spirit shards or empty pouches.
Thera can teleport to large Summoning obelisks in unlocked regions.
Grimy herbs can be toggled to become unfinished potions as they are cleaned.
Cleaning one grimy herb cleans all matching grimy herbs in the inventory.
Herbs and charms can be obtained while Mining, Fishing, Woodcutting, siphoning Divination springs, and excavating Archaeology hotspots.
Monster charm drops are multiplied by 5.
Potion making has a 75% chance to save the secondary ingredient.
All Meilyr combination potion recipes are unlocked.
Skill-boosting familiars give triple their normal skill boost.
Summoning has a 50% chance to create an extra banked pouch and always banks 10 matching scrolls; extras give no XP.
Divination springs always yield enriched memories.
Memory conversion and divine-energy conversion use half the normal energy, rounded down.
Converting memories has a 10% chance to bank a porter or divine charge.
Crafting from divine energy uses half the usual energy.
Memory strands are gained at 10x the normal rate.
Chronicle fragments give double Hunter XP before League multipliers.

passive_effects: League XP multiplier is 8x.
Thaler gain is multiplied by 10.
Selected region drops are 2x as common.
Slayer points and Reaper points from completed assignments are multiplied by 5.
Heart of Gielinor, Menaphos, and Farming reputation gains are multiplied by 5.
Archaeology lore pages are 30% more common.

3.name: Voidwalker
effects: The abyssal conduit gives unlimited teleports to destinations covered by many common teleport jewellery items in unlocked regions.
Skilling can produce void shards.
Each void shard contains a clue scroll plus one additional reward roll from its League reward pool.

passive_effects: Applicable skillcape and master-skillcape perks become passive at level 99, except Defence; master perks apply even without level 120.
Monster kills have a 10% chance to award 8 common or uncommon Invention materials.
Dungeoneering token gain is multiplied by 3, including Elite Dungeons.

2.name: Transmutation
effects: The Deities' Transmuter enables two transmutation spells while carried.
Alchemical Divergence converts up to 10 resources to a lower tier.
Alchemical Convergence converts up to 10 resources to a higher tier.
The transmutation spells have no level requirement.
Each transmuted item awards 10 base Magic XP before League multipliers.
The spells automatically recast over time on a stack of noted resources.
A toggle can bank the noted transmutation products.
Using a resource on the Transmuter shows its conversion result.

passive_effects: League XP multiplier is 12x.
Selected region drops are 4x as common.
All toolbelt items are unlocked.
Monster kills have a 20% chance to award 12 common or uncommon Invention materials.
God Wars Dungeon and Heart of Gielinor encounters require no killcount.
Ascension Keystones are not required to fight the Legiones.
Keys to the Crossing are not required to fight the Magister.

3.name: Devout
effects: The Devout Yak familiar has 32 inventory slots.
The familiar can note/unnote items and open the bank from anywhere.
Ethereal storage scrolls repeat the previous unnote action.
Stat-boosting familiars award 10 base XP in their matching skill when you gain XP in it, at most once every 6 seconds.
Summoning scrolls are not consumed.
Familiar spell-point costs are reduced to 10% of normal.
Combat familiar damage scales with Summoning level, reaching up to 500% bonus damage at level 99.

passive_effects: Selected region drops are 6x as common.
The Sage can swap between already-unlocked spellbooks and prayer books.
Soul Reaper assignments can be chosen.
Monster kills have a 20% chance to award 20 common or uncommon Invention materials.
Augmented items gain item XP 4x faster.
Dungeoneering token gain is multiplied by 5, including Elite Dungeons.

1.name: Perkfection
effects: The Inventor's Toolbox acts as an XP capacitor with 10x charge capacity and 10x charge rate.
The Toolbox provides two additional gizmo slots on top of an augmented item's normal perks.
The Toolbox gives unlimited teleports to Inventor's workbenches in unlocked regions.
Junk chance can be toggled to 0% when disassembling.
Disassembly produces 10x materials.
Invention machines are available from level 1, work 10x faster, and hold 10x capacity.
Machines and augmented items consume no charge.
Helpful perks trigger 20% more often, without stacking with the normal item-level-20 benefit.
All dwarven and cave-goblin technology blueprints are unlocked.

2.name: Rejuvenated
effects: Choose one additional relic from any previous tier.

passive_effects: League XP multiplier is 16x.
Selected region drops are 8x as common.
All Seren spells and Seren prayers are unlocked, though their prerequisite spell/prayer books still need to be unlocked.

1.name: Infernal Fire
effects: The Avernic Star works from the inventory or pocket slot.
Death Mark always applies for every combat style and executes targets at 20% life points.
Death Mark kills award 5% adrenaline.
When pocketed, the Avernic Star provides combat and Prayer bonuses.

2.name: Naragi Edict
effects: The Sliver of Edicts can be activated every 90 seconds for 16.8 seconds.
While active it heals 10,000 life points four times at 4.2-second intervals.
While active it raises combat levels to 255 and can revive you on death.
When pocketed it provides armour, combat-damage, Prayer, and life-point bonuses.

3.name: Icyenic Faith
effects: The Tome of the Icyene grants +50 Prayer bonus when worn.
Each point of Prayer bonus adds 0.2% critical-strike chance and 0.2% base ability damage.
Protection prayers and deflection curses block 100% of damage and also act as Soul Split.

passive_effects: Selected region drops are 10x as common.
Advance Time can be cast without limit.

1.name: Teragard's Aegis
effects: Base ability damage and natural health regeneration scale upward with armour value, with larger bonuses while using a defender or shield.

2.name: Big Boned
effects: Maximum life points are increased by 50%.
Damage dealt gains bonus damage equal to 5% of maximum life points.

3.name: Adrenaline Junkie
effects: Maximum adrenaline is increased by 50%.
Adrenaline generation is increased by 50%.

passive_effects: 50% chance to save combat runes, rolled separately per rune type.
50% chance to save ammunition in combat.
50% chance to save ectoplasm and necrotic runes used by abilities/incantations.
Activating a tier-1 blessing grants one blessing reset.

1.name: Striking Light
effects: Basic-attack damage is increased by 40%.
Basic attacks periodically trigger Light of Saradomin for additional damage.

2.name: Barkscales
effects: Incoming damage is reduced based on armour value.
After five reductions, Grasp of Guthix triggers at the attacker and deals area poison damage.

3.name: Abyssal Cinders
effects: Attacks deal 15% ability damage as bonus damage on hit.
Hits have a 5% chance to trigger Inferno of Zamorak for additional single-target damage.

passive_effects: Dive is automatically unlocked.
Attack range is increased by one game square, capped at 10 squares.

1.name: Steadfast Will
effects: Several shield/defender abilities receive major offensive, cooldown, reflection, and duration improvements.

2.name: Eternal Sustenance
effects: Food is not consumed when eaten.
Eating food costs no adrenaline.

3.name: Avernic Rampage
effects: Attacks have a 5% chance to trigger a 7.2-second state where abilities and special attacks cost no adrenaline.

passive_effects: 75% chance to save combat runes, ammunition, ectoplasm, and necrotic runes.
Movement-ability cooldowns are reduced to 4.2 seconds except Barge and Greater Barge.
Nature's rune pouch is granted and can hold four rune types.

1.name: Sacred Fervor
effects: Melee, Magic, Ranged, and Necromancy ability/special-attack cooldowns are reduced by 30%.

2.name: Splash Zone
effects: Area and multi-target attacks deal 30% more damage.
Area abilities gain additional damage based on target tile size.

3.name: Demon's Mark
effects: Accuracy is always calculated using the target's weakness.

passive_effects: Activating the first God-tier blessing grants one blessing reset.
Araxxi, Rise of the Six, and Vorago rotations can be chosen.

1.name: Higher Power
effects: Base ability damage is increased by 30%.
Berserk, Death's Swiftness, Living Death, and Sunshine become unavailable.

2.name: True Equilibrium
effects: For each distinct blessing path represented across tiers 1-6, gain a stack of offensive and defensive stats.
Each stack grants base ability damage, armour, life points, critical chance, critical damage, and Prayer bonus; one/two/three unique paths grant one/two/three stacks.

3.name: Havoc Born
effects: Damage is increased by 20%.
Maximum life points and armour value are each reduced by 25%.

passive_effects: All War's Wares rewards are unlocked.
Maximum adrenaline is increased by 25%.

1.name: Lord of Light
effects: Basic attacks periodically trigger multiple Light of Saradomin strikes near the target; Prayer bonus increases their damage and they heal you for part of damage dealt.

2.name: Tearing Thorns
effects: Damage-over-time abilities last twice as long.
Every fifth damage-over-time hit triggers Grasp of Guthix, whose damage also scales with maximum life points.

3.name: Unholy Critual
effects: Gain 15% critical-strike chance.
Critical chance above 50% converts to critical damage.
Inferno of Zamorak gains critical damage and triggers on critical strikes.

passive_effects: God books/scriptures/grimoires and scrimshaws do not consume charge.
Equipment does not degrade.

1.name: Tempered Heart
effects: Generate 6% adrenaline every 1.2 seconds.

2.name: Envenomed
effects: Poison damage gains a large bonus that further scales with Herblore level.
Damaging a target temporarily removes its poison immunity.

3.name: Perfidious
effects: Inferno of Zamorak activation chance is multiplied by 5.
Grasp of Guthix needs only two qualifying reductions/hits.
Light of Saradomin cooldown is reduced to 4.8 seconds.

passive_effects: 95% chance to save combat runes, ammunition, ectoplasm, and necrotic runes.

1.name: Genesis Essence
effects: Equipped weapons are treated as tier 120.

2.name: Power Archive
effects: An Automaton Control Bot stores up to 20 weapon/armour gizmos and grants their effects while augmented gear is worn.
Ranks of scalable combat perks in stored gizmos are doubled.

3.name: Chaotic Insight
effects: Each combat equipment item counts as two additional pieces toward its set effect.

passive_effects: Activating the second God-tier blessing grants one blessing reset.
